Record Class EffectOptions

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.api.EffectOptions
Record Components:
palette - immutable nonempty RGB colors, copied and masked to 24 bits
values - explicit numeric or text options, copied before use
public record EffectOptions(List<Integer> palette, Map<String,Object> values) extends Record
Keeps reusable colors and option values for creating text effects.

For example, keep an orange-to-yellow palette and create a wave from it at several playback speeds. Changing an option returns a separate value, leaving the original unchanged; this is why the options are described as immutable. The palette and option map are copied. The selected movement's own validator still runs in create(String, float, float, float), with that effect's existing defaults.

    • create

      public IChromaticEffect create(String movement, float colorSpeed, float moveSpeed, float playback)
      Creates the selected effect after checking its option names, ranges, and combinations with that effect's validator. An unknown effect or rejected option throws; creating the effect does not register a formatting name.
      Parameters:
      movement - registered movement name or descriptor
      colorSpeed - finite color constructor control
      moveSpeed - finite motion constructor control
      playback - independent playback multiplier in -32..32
      Returns:
      fresh validated effect; nothing is registered or drawn
